access_note: Article describes CSV output, but repository lists XLSX workbooks. Formats recorded from the repository.
description: Institución Universitaria Pascual Bravo publishes electrical measurements from a university laboratory collected from April to December 2024. The Zenodo listing contains Excel workbooks with three-phase voltages and currents, active and reactive power, power factor and frequency. CC BY 4.0 allows free reuse. The observations can calibrate laboratory load and power-quality simulations, or serve as anomaly-detection and demand-forecasting benchmarks. Coverage is limited to one facility and does not establish campus-wide or regional consumption. The article describes curated CSV tables, whereas the inspected repository lists XLSX files; this format difference is retained, not assumed resolved. No payloads were inspected. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Electrical Measurement Dataset from a University Laboratory for Smart Energy Applications
